## BOOKING - Instagram Inbox Poller
Fallback for when Meta does not deliver the `messages` webhook: every 20 seconds it reads the Page's Instagram conversations and hands each new customer message to **Instagram Reply** without waiting, so a slow model reply never makes the next poll pick the same message up again.
Uses the **Meta Page Access Token** credential. Unpublish this workflow once the webhook in **Incoming Social Message** works, or customers get two replies.

meta.description: Polls the Instagram inbox every 20 seconds and answers new DMs; a fallback for the Meta messages webhook.
